name: jj (Jujutsu)
description: Installs jj (Jujutsu), a Git-compatible version control system.

completionMode.description: Select shell completion mode for bash/zsh/fish. 'dynamic' is recommended by jj docs.

configureUserFromGit.description: If true, read git global user.name/user.email and set jj user.name/user.email (skips if jj user config already exists).
